title: Peformance Team // Recap
summary: The week of Oct 19 was far behind plan: 1,200 new customers against 4,600, $124,000 new-customer revenue against $504,000, and 0.65 first-order ROAS against 0.90, with a $157 cost per new customer against $122. Repeat orders ran about 1,000 above plan and softened the miss. Creative output reached only about 60% of the concepts needed.
points: MAIA's main campaign improved toward 0.9 ROAS after prioritising video and launching an unaware ad
AVIA stayed below target and needs a dedicated strategist, stronger cortisol angles and more videos
Brain, Prostate, Neuropathy and Cholesterol are the priority angles; the brain page's mechanism must be fixed
AppLovin will send Cholesterol ads straight to the product page before trying a matching quiz funnel
decisions: Track net-new concepts in ClickUp with a creative-status field
Keep Wednesday calls and add Monday business review sessions
Add Damian to the business reviews

tasksImported.title: Add a creative-status field in ClickUp and require it on every creative
Schedule the Monday business review sessions and add Damian
Set up backup ad accounts, profiles and machines and start warming them
Fix the brain landing page mechanism
Onboard the AVIA creative strategist and pick the cortisol angles to prioritise
Get an AppLovin account manager and test the product page route
Raise the MAIA budget while performance holds
Launch brain, neuropathy and prostate creatives
Add AVIA video creatives and test new angles
